criteria.rationale: The agent:independent- prefix is a declaration required by the engine, not authenticated identity. Maintainer-authorized reviewer is Codex/OpenAI, another vendor than implementer Claude/Anthropic. Identity is declared and pose-dist attestations are unsigned. No execution digest or Anthropic session marker is invented in this reviewing environment.

Resume and handoff share one predecessor claim and receipts. Exactly one winner in the concurrent independent race; mixed chains preserve history, budgets and watch order. Same-attempt accounting and opening-agent ceiling remain in force.

CLI handoff, optional hands_off_from/handoff_renderer records and normalized call ordinals preserve existing reads. Historical proofs from eb4ad73,341aa5e,0ac1cb6 verify without rewriting records; versioned runs never fall back.

Completed/same-agent runs, missing attempts, recordless stalls, conflicting explicit destination, spent budget and invalid wait bound are refused with reasons. Unknown renderer and forged brief/section are rejected; raw paths, session and environment controls remain bounded.

Native CLI/domain dispatch, normalized events, shared continuation ledger, version-aware proof and watch/wait paths compose capability:delegation-handoff. Integration assessment was executed; 63 existing unobserved external consumers are diagnostics, not claimed external adoption.

Initial command, ls and wait carry truthful next_actions with unavailable reasons and explicit no-op cancel. Watch marks resume versus handoff in order; interrupted predecessor stays partial/unknown and only successor concludes.

Unversioned immutable runs reconstruct against current,V1,V0 only when the section digest matches; explicitly versioned runs never fall back. Raw-ID, anonymous and no-events history remains readable. The base/wire digest and signed canonical record bind the selected section.

B01-B09 and F01-F03 reconciled. Fifteen literal upgrade cases from eb4ad73,341aa5e,0ac1cb6 pass against the current binary. Prior independent probes and version-isolation/forgery refusals pass under race. No unresolved finding remains.

D1 preserves the original attempt ceiling rather than allowing vendor alternation to increase it. D2 bounds and quotes only recorded partial/commands and requires re-verification. D4 reuses one claim and receipt across resume/handoff. Renderer versioning repairs B09 without restoring unsafe pairing for new runs.

Four manuals, help catalog and changelog match the implemented handoff semantics. Final trace/report will record R10 as deferred and identity limitations. The unrelated 841fc2b documentary changes are excluded.

Stopped command results, ls and wait disclose executable next_actions or unavailable reasons. Cancel is an explicit no-op on a stopped run; terminal choices wait for an answer, including after handoff. Auto retries return the existing continuation; conflicting explicit destination is refused.

R1-R9 verified within D1-D4 boundaries. R10 is deferred to pose-delegated-review-round-protocol, not satisfied. Attempt ceiling is the opening agents; only the successor concludes. Renderer version 2 is recorded and unversioned runs cover all three historical renderers.

Milestone continuity delivers cross-agent handoff on the existing attempt and claim. Recordless stalls are refused under D4. Thread/current-session integration remains deferred under D3. Implementation is Claude/Anthropic session f2a4d9f2-d557-4064-ae96-6ed52bb47cd2; seal lead is explicitly anthropic/claude-opus-5-5 from the Codex reviewer environment.

Partial output remains quoted and cannot become a gate verdict. Call ordinals disclose no raw credential/session value in normalized persisted/live events. New runs remain renderer 2; forged digest, removed version and unknown version are refused. Exclusive predecessor claim, private session storage and containment remain intact.

The smallest sufficient continuation reuses the attempt, claim, budget and containment. Two legacy command renderers exist only for immutable proof reconstruction; a third candidate is necessary for the unversioned 0ac1cb6 producer. No thread/session contract or general task execution is fabricated.
